text:
nora: morning! first day — quick setup blockers: 1) Figma invite accepted but the Design System library shows "Request access" 2) can't find my squad roadmap in Notion 3) how do i get in the research participant pool and the scheduling calendar? also what's our prototype naming convention so tooling picks it up? thanks!
samir: welcome nora! ping me your SSO email here and i'll add you to the right group. For DS edit perms we map to a linked GitHub handle, paste it when you have it. Roadmap is Notion -> Product -> Roadmaps -> Horizon (i'll add you).
nora: nora.li@redwood.ai
carmen: added nora to `design:horizon` and gave view + comment on DS. if you need edit perms, share GH handle and i'll grant.
nora: @carmen my GH is `nli-gh`
design-ops-bot: To request edit access run `/access request design-system` and include your GitHub handle. Research participant pool: Notion -> Research Ops -> Participant Pool. To schedule studies post in #research-scheduling and add events to the Research Calendar. If SSO fails, run `/ticket create "SSO: Figma access"` with your email.
samir: prototype naming: canonical pattern is `proto/<team>-<feature>-v1` (kebab-case) and files starting with `proto/` are auto-indexed. Example: `proto/horizon-onboarding-v1`.
nora: all set 10: can see the DS and roadmap now, filing the access request for edit. thanks everyone :tada:
